run_biped_locomotion_demo: run the biped locomotion demo program with AI4Animation to animate a bipedal character using neural network predictions
create_actor_with_model: create an Actor entity from a GLB model file with full body bone names using AI4Animation Scene
build_leg_ik_solver: build a LegIK solver using FABRIK for hip-to-ankle and ankle-to-ball bone chains to solve foot contact
predict_motion_sequence: predict a future motion sequence by feeding actor transforms, velocities, and guidance into a PyTorch neural network model
animate_character_with_guidance: animate a bipedal character by blending predicted motion sequences with IK solvers and guidance templates for style control
